nodes.name: Fetch Script Titles
nodes.notes: Chapter titles for the impact cards come from the script's [CHAPTER n: title] markers. Missing script degrades to the narration-excerpt fallback.

parameters.query:
-- The script that belongs to this project, newest first.
--
-- This used to read the script id out of the project's `scripts` link field.
-- That field only ever existed in Airtable: hov.at_project does not emit it,
-- so the expression fell through to the literal 'missing', no row came back,
-- and the render got no chapter titles at all. Ask the script instead: it
-- carries the link the other way round, as 'Associated Project'.
--
-- Through the view, not the base table, because everything else this
-- workflow reads is a hov.at_* view and a base-table grant is not something
-- the render path should be the first to discover it lacks.
select id, "createdTime", fields
from hov.at_script
where fields->'Associated Project' @> $hov$["{{ $('Fetch Project Info').first().json.id }}"]$hov$::jsonb
order by "createdTime" desc
limit 1

nodes.name: Find Music Folder
nodes.notes: Background music lives in the user's Drive folder named 'Muzica'. Missing folder = video without music, never an error.

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?pageSize=200&fields=files(id,name,mimeType)&q=' + encodeURIComponent("'" + ((($json.files || [])[0] || {}).id || 'missing') + "' in parents and trashed = false") }}

nodes.name: Caption Colour
nodes.notes: Editing Options.captionColor -> the captionColor prop. Absent means white captions with the spoken word marked by brightness, which is the default because it is the only accent that reads on every kind of footage.
